summary: Iteration 120: Testing ProjectDetail improvements - Header redesign (3 blocks), notification contacts loading, and template selector. All 14 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend testing revealed and fixed a bug in template selection that caused 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' error. After fix, all features work correctly.

issues: React hydration warnings about <tr> inside <span> and <span> inside <tbody> - cosmetic only, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Template selection in 'Otras Notificaciones' dialog was crashing because system templates have 'body_html' field instead of 'body'. Fixed by using optional chaining and fallback to empty string.
